locator: V.4.1, τὸ δὴ τοιοῦτον ἓν μόνον ... οὐχ ἓν ἂν εἴη τὰ ἄμφω
interpretation: Source reading recorded in prose only. Records Plotinus’s uniqueness conclusion and his reason that another such principle would leave the pair not one. It does not advertise a verified inference from individual simplicity or refute plural simples without the source’s stronger unity and global-priority commitments.
